articles.title: Japan’s New Disaster Agency Renews Household Stockpile Advice
articles.description: The agency prefers a week of supplies and recommends three liters of drinking water per person each day.

articles.title: 'Save yourself': Japan launches new disaster agency, urges citizens to stockpile food and water for seven days
articles.description: Japan has urged its citizens to stockpile food and water in preparation for potential natural disasters. The government emphasizes individual preparedness due to possible delays in emergency services. Authorities recommend maintaining at least three days' worth of supplies, ideally extending this to one week. The new Disaster Prevention Agency will coordinate disaster management efforts nationwide, focusing on earthquake risks and other emergencies.
